cause: Daylight portrait textures were drawn after pre-darkened night plates, reality-mode wash and blackout zone masks, so they bypassed the wall illumination. Runtime gold frames also used their ungraded color.
fix: Tint the portrait, matte and runtime frame from local wall/painted-image luminance and hue in the actual current plate, only for night/evening/blackout states. Replay existing reality-mode crossfade and blackout masks only where dynamic portrait pixels replaced the wall. Keep depth, picker and all authored interactions.
caching: Texture get_image/decompress happens only on the first unseen resource_path. Local illumination samples are cached by current plate path plus target id. Repeated draws/mode switches perform cache lookups and small existing Canvas draws, with no repeated readback or wall sampling.

validation.phaseScope: All A1/A2/A3, four night/evening/blackout and two daylight states, both reality modes; raw face highlights compared to actual neighboring wall pixels, real Canvas draw calls, state invariance and20 authored biography consumers/reads. A2 has no honor portraits and remains empty.

limits: Headless Canvas commands and real texture pixel checks are automated evidence. Root computer-use reload/visual acceptance is separate.
No claim that the existing high-CPU process or slow CUA screenshot was caused by this change; that process predates the new renderer.
No gameplay, collision, door/progression gate, main/focus, source asset, Git or packaging changes in this repair.
